notes: BND-96. Variants: pre = 38f86d4 (BND-68 before merging main's BND-36), main = 07b27be, branch = 08a5212. Binaries built from these trees with bend -o x.c and clang -std=c11 -O3.
The Boat hosts were shared with other large sandboxes during both runs; CPU steal was about 1.6% of all jiffies over the 7-sample run and higher in bursts, which widened the ranges.
additionalRuns holds an earlier 3-sample run of the same binaries on another sandbox, kept for completeness: it measured hello at 0.827 of pre on a host whose steal rose during the run.
All samples had zero errors and passed the status, body and middleware-header checks.
